plannedSlices.title: Map/Scenario GDExtension Persistence Foundation
sourceDocs: 2026-05-03 owner direction: maps/scenarios need structure and persistence; prefer C++ Godot GDExtension map system
plannedSlices.purpose: Define and then implement a typed, durable map/scenario persistence architecture so authored and generated maps are first-class assets instead of loose JSON/dictionary payloads embedded into scenario content and session saves.
currentInspectionFindings: RandomMapGeneratorRules.generate(input_config) returns large nested Dictionary payloads with scenario_record, metadata, staging, validation/report, and provenance rather than a typed map object.

ScenarioSelectRules launches generated skirmishes by handing the generated payload to ScenarioFactory.create_generated_skirmish_session(...), preserving no-authored-writeback and memory/session-only boundaries.
Authored scenarios are bundled in content/scenarios.json with scenario metadata, terrain rows, objectives, script hooks, and placements in one JSON domain.
SaveService._save_raw_dictionary() serializes full payload dictionaries with JSON.stringify(payload, "\t") and writes raw JSON strings through FileAccess.
A Small 36x36 generated map profile wrote about 6.95 MB of JSON and measured roughly 202-219 ms in the save path, so full-payload JSON saves are already expensive before larger maps.
implementationTargets: future C++ Godot GDExtension map package module and GDScript adapter API
completionCriteria: Define typed MapDocument and ScenarioDocument boundaries with explicit schema/version, stable ids, metadata, terrain/layer data, object placements, route/validation metadata, and generated provenance.

Plan save files around immutable map package references plus compact mutable session deltas rather than full map/scenario JSON rewrites where practical.
Plan content/scenarios.json migration toward a compact manifest/index with separate authored/generated map package files.
Define a staged bridge from current GDScript RMG dictionary output into the new package format before any full C++ generator rewrite.
Name rollback, compatibility, validation scene/report, and performance acceptance gates before implementation begins.
baselineChecks: focused generated-map save/load, scenario-load, and RMG validation smokes selected at kickoff
nonGoals: No immediate coding or coding-agent implementation during planning refinement.

both_t4_t5_initiative_6.reason: Suppressed most Veilmourn week-2 dominance but overcorrected the Thornwake matchup to Thornwake over Veilmourn 81.5%.

implemented_tuning: unit_veilmourn_obituary_scribes kept at initiative 7 after the T5-lowered test proved worse than T4-only
evidence.remaining_failure: Full matrix is still needs_tuning. Veilmourn remains high in week 2 against Sunvault 75.0 and Mireclaw 70.0, while other non-Veilmourn pair outliers remain. This is a partial tuning slice, not a final balance claim.

shield_and_micro_tuning_pass.scope: Conservative content-only stat tuning after the 32-outlier post-Veilmourn-T4-initiative baseline. Tested shielding first, then narrow damage ceilings where shield-only did not affect the ranged spike.
rejected_candidates: Broad shield/non-shield cluster: worsened or flipped several rows in 30-seed smoke.
Shield-only broad buffs: full 100-seed matrix worsened from 32 to 37 outliers; it fixed some Thornwake rows but created larger Embercourt exposure and did not move Veilmourn over Sunvault/Mireclaw.
Narrow shield plus Veilmourn T5 shots: full 100-seed matrix stayed at 32 outliers and did not move the top Veilmourn rows because shots were not the binding constraint.
shield_and_micro_tuning_pass.remaining_failure: Full matrix remains needs_tuning. Added Brasshollow over Veilmourn week 2 at 62.5 and Brasshollow over Thornwake week 3 at 58.5, so the pass improves severity but does not complete the combat-balance slice.

owner_requested_micro_tuning_2026_05_27.scope: Owner-requested small stat tuning for Brasshollow, Mireclaw, Thornwake, and Veilmourn using the fast faction battle matrix.
accepted_changes: Brasshollow Scrip Haulers and Rivet Hounds now carry defensive-only shielding; Rivet Hounds HP is 10 -> 9.
Brasshollow shielding no longer implicitly enables the dormant round-three Brasshollow faction damage bonus unless a shielding ability explicitly declares brasshollow_pressure_damage_multiplier > 1.
Defensive-only shielding with cohesion_hold_bonus: 0 no longer grants extra cohesion base in live rules or the fast benchmark.
Thornwake Graft Matriarchs HP is 50 -> 51 and Worldroot Bastion HP is 102 -> 104.
Veilmourn Obituary Scribes trade ranged spike for staying power: HP 25 -> 28 and max_damage 11 -> 10.
rejected_changes: Mireclaw T1/T2/T3 early buffs were tested but not kept; the package widened early and midgame outliers, including 38 outliers in the first 30-seed full-package smoke and 33 outliers in the 100-seed reduced package.
Brasshollow cohesion-hold shield compensation was tested but not kept; it overcorrected Brasshollow to 39 outliers at 30 seeds.
Brasshollow T1 HP-only trimming was tested but not kept; it created severe anti-Brasshollow week 1 and week 2 rows in the 30-seed smoke.
Brasshollow T2 defense compensation was tested but not kept after the 100-seed run produced 33 outliers.
owner_requested_micro_tuning_2026_05_27.remaining_risk: This is a directional owner-requested micro-tuning pass, not final balance. It keeps side bias low but leaves 32 pair outliers and deliberately rejects the tested Mireclaw early buffs for now.

implemented_changes: Veilmourn Obituary Scribes max_damage 10 -> 9 to reduce week-2 ranged burst without lowering initiative.
Veilmourn Mirrorkeel Reavers HP 50 -> 52 and Fogbound Leviathan HP 102 -> 105 to keep late Veilmourn identity durable after ranged burst trim.
Thornwake Worldroot Bastion HP 104 -> 102 to slightly soften the week-3 Sunvault/Thornwake severe row without touching Thornwake root-control identity.
rejected_what_ifs: Fogwake Step +2 and/or Obituary Scribes initiative 6 over-nerfed Veilmourn and created severe late anti-Veilmourn rows.
Thornwake root initiative/payoff nerfs were effectively no-op or worsened the full 100-seed matrix.
Veilmourn T4 pressure trims overcorrected late Veilmourn matchups.
Thornwake T5 initiative 6 produced severe week-4 anti-Thornwake outliers.
Veilmourn T5 HP 30 plus damage trim reduced 65%+ rows in smoke but regressed total 100-seed outliers.
severe_65plus_outlier_tuning_20260527.remaining_risk: The severe-outlier profile improved, but total 55%+ outlier count remains needs_tuning at 34. Continue tuning from the remaining Sunvault/Thornwake, Sunvault/Veilmourn, Embercourt/Mireclaw, and Brasshollow/Sunvault rows; do not mark final combat balance complete.
